subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary The text is about the importance of self-control. It is, in fact, the origin of all other virtues. However, human beings have strong and vicious desires. If a man fails to control them, he can conquer animality. Only self-control can give him moral freedom. A man who can rule his own spirit deserves praise. A man with self-controlling power is the strongest man. So we should cultivate this habit of self- control watchfully. It will build up our character.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Shahpur Secondary School, Dumuria, Khulna. Sl. No. 74; Page No. 122
